views.front: The classic toilet retains a recessed bowl, separate tall cistern and solid supporting pedestal.
views.rear: The rear tank and bowl connection remain coherent with a continuous porcelain finish.
views.detail: The seat rim, bowl recession and tank lid stay distinct in the close view.
views.underside: The bowl underside meets the closed pedestal and the tank stays supported behind it.
views.clay: Clay confirms the separate cistern and genuinely recessed bowl rather than a solid oval form.
